items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Hartman and I, we're roommates for a quick minute there.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. [affirmative] Billy Eckstein, Dinah Washington, of course, Johnny Hartman [phonetic sp.]. Johnny Hartman and I, we're roommates for a quick minute there. And also Chano Pozo [phonetic sp.]. You know. What other singers did we? Oh, man.
And these were all singers who were very much respected -­
